ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low internal contrast; the ventral surface is dominated by low-intensity (near-black) pixels with a ratio of high-intensity pixels localized primarily at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly uniform dark pigmentation (Type 1) across the entire visible ventral surface; absence of high-contrast contiguous geometric blobs or mottling except for high-contrast focal points at the lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow U-shaped depression; pixel-estimated angle of approximately 115 degrees with a low depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary featuring low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations across both lobes, with more pronounced jaggedness at the outer distal margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the central trailing edge transitioning to slightly blunt, thickened distal terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast off-white pixel clusters (rosettes) localized specifically at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, indicating heavy localized barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, horizontally-aligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the medial-to-distal region of the right lobe (viewer perspective).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle colonization causing structural thickening at the fluke tips; minor nicks and irregularities along the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant symmetrical clustering of external organisms on both fluke tips creates a unique 'bulbous' terminal geometry.
